How to organize pdf pages

  1. Choose a PDF from your device.
  2. Move pages up or down, rotate sideways pages, or remove pages you do not need.
  3. Save the updated PDF and check that its order looks right.

Page cards show page numbers rather than thumbnails. The original file is never changed; you download a separate PDF.

Keep a PDF in the right order

Use the page cards to assemble a cleaner version of an existing PDF. You can move a title page to the front, remove a blank scan, or rotate one landscape sheet that was saved sideways. The numbered cards show original page numbers, while “Position” shows where each page will appear in the final document.

For accuracy, this version does not claim to offer page-thumbnail previews. If visual previews are important for your documents, open the downloaded PDF and check its contents before sending it. Complex forms and digitally signed documents may be affected by page copying.

Frequently asked questions

Can I undo changes?

You can restore the original arrangement with Reset all pages before saving.

Does this tool delete pages from my original file?

No. It only changes the PDF that you download.

Can I organize password-protected PDFs?

No, this tool requires an unlocked PDF.
